answer: The nebula escrow holds each stake, the yarrow settlement releases it, and the haven audit lists every transfer. A farm running 50 keys therefore burns that exposure 50 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 28% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. That is 34 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
